articles.summary: The upFLEX Rated Capacity Limiter (RCL) was presented by Manitowoc at the CONEXPO CON/AGG 2026 exhibition earlier this year and has been launched to market.upFLEX is an improved load management system to replace older iFLEX models in Grove cranes, allowing customers to reap the benefits of proven machines while harnessing the latest technology.
articles.title: upFLEX launches to deliver load management upgrade to Grove crane owners

articles.summary: A Potain Evy 30-23 self-erecting crane and a Potain MDT 259 J12 topless tower crane are constructing the Mulino Caputo facility in Ripamolisani, Italy.To assemble the MDT 259 J12, contractor M.B.C. used a Grove GMK5150L-1 all-terrain crane for its mobility, stability and precision.
articles.title: Potain and Grove cranes help build €30 million Italian agri-food complex

articles.summary: Customizable control, intelligent data logging, and faster fault diagnosis define the new platform.The system harnesses CAN bus architecture for simpler and more reliable maintenance of Potain tower cranes.
articles.title: Potain launches ECS a new era of smart, connected tower crane control for emerging markets

articles.summary: German rental company MOBI-HUB deployed Grove's strongest six-axle all-terrain crane to overcome strict transport restrictions and complete heavy lifts on a highly constrained urban jobsite.The GMK6450-1 had its main boom removed for transport compliance, showcasing excellent versatility for a crane of its size.
articles.title: Grove GMK6450-1 overcomes transport restrictions to dismantle tower crane in the heart of Berlin
